title: TEHRAN - Oct 8, Abbas Araghchi, Iran's FM made remarks in an interview.
text:
TEHRAN - Oct 8, Abbas Araghchi, Iran's FM made remarks in an interview."

""
"SOT, Abbas Araghchi, Iran's Foreign Minister (Farsi): "The negotiation process is still ongoing [with the U.S], and messages are being exchanged through mediators. We presented our proposal, which was titled the "seven-day plan." We have heard the Americans' views in response and are currently reviewing them. I believe we will respond within the next few days. As I mentioned, the negotiation process continues.
